proposals.evidence: CDIAL gives Hindi camṛā, Gujarati cāmḍũ/cāmḍī and Marathi cāmḍẽ/cāmḍī as the historical -ḍ- extension of carman via camma. These survey forms fit that inherited extended family; cāmbḍo additionally has an intrusive b, so it remains qualified. Jambu has a dedicated historical extension node *carmaḍa- (4701-2), which is the selected parent.
